A couple of asks from our side: please include timezone normalized to UTC in the timestamp column and epoch_ms for ease of joining. Also provide a short README describing any redaction rules applied.

Daniel — thanks for the clear list. Quick technical notes from the export side: 

- Export columns we can produce: account_id, actor_id_hashed (SHA-256), actor_type, action, resource_id, timestamp_utc_iso, timestamp_epoch_ms, request_id, region, user_agent, ip_address (IP is retained for 30 days by default).
- Hashing: we will provide salted SHA-256 hashes. The salt is reversible only by us; we can provide a one-way hash if you require non-reversible (we can run a keyed HMAC instead). Tell us which you prefer.
- Formats: we can emit CSV or NDJSON and compress with gzip. For large exports we prefer parquet for speed/cost; for the POC CSV/GZIP is fine.
- Delivery: we support pushing to a pre-provisioned S3 bucket with SSE-KMS. We will also provide a small README and the md5 checksum for each file.

Attached is a small populated sample (medlytics_who_when_sample.csv) that follows the columns Daniel listed. It's intentionally synthetic and includes the two timestamp formats to validate joins.

If this matches what you expect we'll schedule the full 90-day extract to run overnight and plan secure delivery on Friday.
